text: The Patriots head to Chicago for Thursday Night Football in Week 7 riding the momentum of a 26-19 win over the Jets, in which Drake Maye threw three touchdown passes to improve New England to 2-0 in the AFC East, though the victory came with injury complications: Romeo Doubs suffered a shoulder injury on a 42-yard TD catch early in the first quarter and has since been placed on injured reserve, while A.J. Brown, returning from a four-week absence due to a right high ankle sprain, struggled with a career-high three dropped passes in his first game back. The Patriots have responded to the Doubs loss by signing DB Elliott Davison to the 53-man roster from the practice squad and adding WR Ryan Miller, OL Jacob Rizy, and G Andrew Rupcich to the practice squad, with CB D'Shawn Jamison released from the practice squad. Head Coach Mike Vrabel addressed the team this week at his Tuesday press conference, and the Patriots will look to stay undefeated in division play when they face the Bears on Thursday at 8:15 PM ET.
